crossRefs.note: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

people.name: Tamar
people.line: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah

people.name: Timnah
people.line: Canaanite city associated with Judah and Dan

translations.web: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
translations.bsb: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,”
translations.kjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
translations.asv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.
